create_balance_task: create a Cartpole Balance task environment with default 10 second time limit and smooth reward
create_balance_sparse_task: create a Cartpole Balance task environment with sparse reward for benchmarking
create_swingup_task: create a Cartpole Swing-Up task environment starting the pole pointing toward the ground
create_multi_pole_task: create a Cartpole task environment with two or three poles for advanced balancing
generate_cartpole_model: generate a MuJoCo XML model string for a cart with N poles using _make_model
